article.story: PITTSBURGH -- — Reserve Josh Smith scored 18 points and Duquesne beat Howard 74-68 on Wednesday. Smith shot 4 for 7 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 9 of 11 from the free-throw line for the Dukes (5-0). Arness Lawson added 12 points while shooting 5 of 8 from the field and 2 for 5 from the line while they also had five rebounds. Ege Demir had 12 points and shot 5 of 8 from the field. Cedric Taylor III finished with 21 points for the Bison (3-3). James Brown added 14 points and eight rebounds for Howard. Smith scored seven points in the first half and Duquesne went into the break trailing 30-28. Smith scored Duquesne’s final six points. Up next Duquesne’s next game is Sunday against Wyoming, and Howard hosts Notre Dame (MD) on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
